scope: Complete six-declaration denominator for internal/formula/{analyze,properties,range,remap,token}_test.go. Static Go formula/range parser and insertion-reference API profile only. No worksheet rewrite, formula evaluation, ECMA conformance, Office rendering or cross-runtime execution credit. Existing native XLSX cache/overwrite workflow IDs describe different operations and are not claimed.

verifiedAspects: Six named literal source rows require nil analysis error, exact reference count and nonempty byte spans within the source
Quoted O'Brien range checks sheet name, endpoint coordinates, absolute flags and span covering the whole source
Selected unsupported/malformed expressions require a non-nil error and zero references
gaps: The new refusal outline selects seven of the source's twenty invalid rows; remaining names, bounds and malformed grammar inputs still need canonical rows
The count cases do not check each endpoint or actual reference substring; no formula evaluation, dependency graph or ECMA grammar-completeness assertion

verifiedAspects: Finite three prefixes by four left cells by four right cells by six operators produce 288 source loop iterations; each yields two references whose source spans re-analyse with matching sheet and endpoints
Row insertion below all references leaves original expression bytes unchanged, and SUM wrapping retains dependencies after subtracting four bytes from reported spans
gaps: The 288 source loop iterations are one planned workflow, not 288 independently measured canonical cases
No test executes a workbook formula, array/spill/dynamic reference, or cross-sheet update; static parser policy is not Excel formula completeness

Six literal fuzz seeds feed a conditional callback. Inputs over 65536 bytes return; analysis refusal only checks that references are empty, and successful analysis checks monotone bounded spans and coordinates

Foreign-sheet remap refusal requires empty output; successful remaps re-analyse and conditionally preserve formulas without an Other! token. Neither branch establishes guaranteed success for an arbitrary seed, exhaustive fuzzing or a new canonical case

verifiedAspects: Six direct input rows compare decoded sheet, first endpoint row and column, and whole-column/whole-row flags
Selected unsupported direct range strings return non-nil errors
gaps: The new refusal outline selects seven of the source's twenty invalid strings
Successful rows do not assert last endpoint values, exact absolute flags or lexical byte spans; reversed range acceptance does not imply normalised output or spreadsheet validity

verifiedAspects: Five literal insertion rows require exact rewritten or unchanged expression string; string literal and unrelated sheet references remain untouched in selected rows
Six invalid insertion parameters and three overflow/dynamic formulas require an error and empty replacement expression; selected seven appear as distinct outline rows
gaps: The invalid outline omits two over-bound insertion arguments; no exact refusal type or no-op delivery to an XLSX package is tested
Case-insensitive sheet matching is seen in one row; no whole-sheet rename, complete formula grammar, reference-aware workbook remap, or transaction rollback is established

verifiedAspects: Selected adjacent string punctuation rows refuse with zero references, while selected quoted punctuation as a function argument or sole literal admits with nil error
gaps: Only five of the source's ten punctuation rows are named; remaining invalid and valid positions are not covered
The native valid tests do not assert reference counts, decoded literal contents or AST values
